title: षष्टितमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 60 · Arjuna sets out and Satyaki guards the king

summary.en: Arjuna arrives, and Yudhishthira embraces him and blesses his task of killing Jayadratha. Arjuna asks Satyaki to guard the king in his absence, and Satyaki goes to Yudhishthira.
summary.kn: ಅರ್ಜುನ ಬರುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಅವನನ್ನು ಆಲಿಂಗಿಸಿ ಜಯದ್ರಥವಧೆಗೆ ಆಶೀರ್ವದಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ತನ್ನ ಅನುಪಸ್ಥಿತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ರಾಜನನ್ನು ಕಾಯಲು ಅರ್ಜುನ ಸಾತ್ಯಕಿಗೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಸಾತ್ಯಕಿ ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನ ಬಳಿ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: अर्जुन आते हैं और युधिष्ठिर उन्हें गले लगाकर जयद्रथ-वध के लिए आशीर्वाद देते हैं। अर्जुन सात्यकि से अपनी अनुपस्थिति में राजा की रक्षा करने को कहते हैं और सात्यकि युधिष्ठिर के पास जाता है।
summary.te: అర్జునుడు వస్తాడు; యుధిష్ఠిరుడు అతన్ని కౌగిలించి జయద్రథ వధకు ఆశీర్వదిస్తాడు. తన లేనప్పుడు రాజును కాపాడమని అర్జునుడు సాత్యకికి చెప్పగా సాత్యకి యుధిష్ఠిరుని వద్దకు వెళతాడు.
summary.ta: அர்ஜுனன் வர, யுதிஷ்டிரர் அவனை அணைத்து ஜயத்ரத வதத்துக்கு ஆசி கூறுகிறார். தன் இல்லாதபோது மன்னரைக் காக்கும்படி அர்ஜுனன் சாத்யகியிடம் கூற, சாத்யகி யுதிஷ்டிரரிடம் செல்கிறான்.
summary.ml: അർജുനൻ എത്തുന്നു; യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ ആലിംഗനം ചെയ്ത് ജയദ്രഥവധമെന്ന ദൗത്യത്തിന് അനുഗ്രഹം നൽകുന്നു. തന്റെ അഭാവത്തിൽ രാജാവിനെ സംരക്ഷിക്കാൻ അർജുനൻ സാത്യകിയോട് ആവശ്യപ്പെടുന്നു; സാത്യകി യുധിഷ്ഠിരന്റെ അടുത്തേക്ക് പോകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.60; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
तथा संभाषतां तेषां प्रादुरासीद्धनंजयः ।
दिदृक्षुर्भरतश्रेष्ठं राजानं ससुहृद्गणम् ॥

meaning.en: While they were speaking thus, Dhananjaya appeared, wishing to see the best of the Bharatas, the king, and his circle of friends.

verses.text:
तं प्रविष्टं शुभां कक्ष्यामभिवाद्याग्रतः स्थितम् ।
समुत्थायार्जुनं प्रेम्णा सस्वजे पाण्डवर्षभः ॥

meaning.en: He entered the fair court, bowed and stood before the king. The Pandava bull rose and embraced Arjuna with love.

verses.text:
मूर्ध्नि चैनमुपाघ्राय परिष्वज्य च बाहुना ।
आशिषः परमाः प्रोच्य स्मयमानोऽभ्यभाषत ॥

meaning.en: Smelling his head and holding him in his arms, he gave him the highest blessings and said, smiling,

verses.text:
व्यक्तमर्जुन संग्रामे ध्रुवस्ते विजयो महान् ।
यादृग्रूपा हि ते छाया प्रसन्नश्च जनार्दनः ॥

meaning.en: "Arjuna, it is clear that you will win a great and certain victory in the battle, since your look is so bright and Janardana is pleased."

verses.text:
तमब्रवीत्ततो जिष्णुर्महदाश्चर्यमुत्तमम् ।
दृष्टवानस्मि भद्रं ते केशवस्य प्रसादजम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Jishnu told him, "May you be well. By Keshava's grace I have seen a great and excellent marvel."

verses.text:
ततस्तत्कथयामास यथादृष्टं धनंजयः ।
आश्वासनार्थं सुहृदां त्र्यम्बकेन समागमम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Dhananjaya related, as he had seen it, his meeting with Tryambaka, to reassure his friends.

verses.text:
ततः शिरोभिरवनिं स्पृष्ट्वा सर्वे च विस्मिताः ।
नमस्कृत्य वृषाङ्काय साधु साध्वित्यथाब्रुवन् ॥

meaning.en: Then all, amazed, touched the ground with their heads, bowed to the bull-marked god and said, "Well done, well done."

verses.text:
अनुज्ञातास्ततः सर्वे सुहृदो धर्मसूनुना ।
त्वरमाणाः सुसंनद्धा हृष्टा युद्धाय निर्ययुः ॥

meaning.en: Then, with leave from Dharma's son, all his friends hurried out, well armed and joyful, to fight.

verses.text:
अभिवाद्य तु राजानं युयुधानाच्युतार्जुनाः ।
हृष्टा विनिर्ययुस्ते वै युधिष्ठिरनिवेशनात् ॥

meaning.en: Having greeted the king, Yuyudhana, Achyuta and Arjuna left Yudhishthira's quarters in high spirits.

verses.text:
रथेनैकेन दुर्धर्षौ युयुधानजनार्दनौ ।
जग्मतुः सहितौ वीरावर्जुनस्य निवेशनम् ॥

meaning.en: The two unassailable heroes, Yuyudhana and Janardana, went together in one chariot to Arjuna's quarters.

verses.text:
तत्र गत्वा हृषीकेशः कल्पयामास सूतवत् ।
रथं रथवरस्याजौ वानरर्षभलक्षणम् ॥

meaning.en: There Hrishikesha, acting as charioteer, prepared the chariot of that best of chariot-fighters for battle, with the sign of the monkey bull on it.

verses.text:
स मेघसमनिर्घोषस्तप्तकाञ्चनसप्रभः ।
बभौ रथवरः कॢप्तः शिशुर्दिवसकृद्यथा ॥

meaning.en: That excellent chariot, thundering like clouds and gleaming like refined gold, shone, made ready, like the newborn sun.

verses.text:
ततः पुरुषशार्दूलः सज्जः सज्जं पुरःसरः ।
कृताह्निकाय पार्थाय न्यवेदयत तं रथम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the tiger among men, himself ready, going before, announced to Partha, who had finished his daily rites, that the chariot was ready.

verses.text:
तं तु लोके वरः पुंसां किरीटी हेमवर्मभृत् ।
बाणबाणासनी वाहं प्रदक्षिणमवर्तत ॥

meaning.en: Kiritin, best of men in the world, wearing golden armour and holding bow and arrows, circled that chariot with his right side toward it.

verses.text:
ततो विद्यावयोवृद्धैः क्रियावद्भिर्जितेन्द्रियैः ।
स्तूयमानो जयाशीभिरारुरोह महारथम् ॥

meaning.en: Then, praised with blessings of victory by men old in learning and years, ritual-doers and masters of their senses, he mounted the great chariot.

verses.text:
जैत्रैः सांग्रामिकैर्मन्त्रैः पूर्वमेव रथोत्तमम् ।
अभिमन्त्रितमर्चिष्मानुदयं भास्करो यथा ॥

meaning.en: That best of chariots had already been consecrated with mantras of victory and battle, and he, blazing, was like the sun rising.

verses.text:
स रथे रथिनां श्रेष्ठः काञ्चने काञ्चनावृतः ।
विबभौ विमलोऽर्चिष्मान्मेराविव दिवाकरः ॥

meaning.en: On the golden chariot, the best of chariot-warriors, clad in gold, shone spotless and radiant, like the sun on Meru.

verses.text:
अन्वारुरोहतुः पार्थं युयुधानजनार्दनौ ।
शर्यातेर्यज्ञमायान्तं यथेन्द्रं देवमश्विनौ ॥

meaning.en: Yuyudhana and Janardana mounted after Partha, as the Ashvins mounted after Indra when he came to Sharyati's sacrifice.

verses.text:
अथ जग्राह गोविन्दो रश्मीन्रश्मिवतां वरः ।
मातलिर्वासवस्येव वृत्रं हन्तुं प्रयास्यतः ॥

meaning.en: Then Govinda, best of those with reins, took the reins, as Matali did for Indra when he set out to kill Vritra.

verses.text:
स ताभ्यां सहितः पार्थो रथप्रवरमास्थितः ।
सहितो बुधशुक्राभ्यां तमो निघ्नन्यथा शशी ॥

meaning.en: Accompanied by those two, Partha rode the finest chariot, like the moon with Mercury and Venus, dispelling darkness.

verses.text:
सैन्धवस्य वधप्रेप्सुः प्रयातः शत्रुपूगहा ।
सहाम्बुपतिमित्राभ्यां यथेन्द्रस्तारकामये ॥

meaning.en: Eager to kill Saindhava, the destroyer of enemy hosts set out, like Indra in the Taraka war with the lord of waters and Mitra.

verses.text:
ततो वादित्रनिर्घोषैर्मङ्गल्यैश्च स्तवैः शुभैः ।
प्रयान्तमर्जुनं सूता मागधाश्चैव तुष्टुवुः ॥

meaning.en: Then, with the sounds of instruments and auspicious, fair praises, charioteers and bards praised Arjuna as he went.

verses.text:
सजयाशीः सपुण्याहः सूतमागधनिस्वनः ।
युक्तो वादित्रघोषेण तेषां रतिकरोऽभवत् ॥

meaning.en: With blessings of victory, auspicious words, the voices of charioteers and bards and the sound of instruments, it became a delight to them.

verses.text:
तमनुप्रयतो वायुः पुण्यगन्धवहः शुचिः ।
ववौ संहर्षयन्पार्थं द्विषतश्चापि शोषयन् ॥

meaning.en: A pure wind carrying holy fragrance blew behind him, gladdening Partha and drying up his foes.

verses.text:
प्रादुरासन्निमित्तानि विजयाय बहूनि च ।
पाण्डवानां त्वदीयानां विपरीतानि मारिष ॥

meaning.en: Many omens appeared for victory for the Pandavas, and the opposite, sir, for your side.

verses.text:
दृष्ट्वार्जुनो निमित्तानि विजयाय प्रदक्षिणम् ।
युयुधानं महेष्वासमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the omens of victory on his right, Arjuna said to the great archer Yuyudhana.

verses.text:
युयुधानाद्य युद्धे मे दृश्यते विजयो ध्रुवः ।
यथा हीमानि लिङ्गानि दृश्यन्ते शिनिपुंगव ॥

meaning.en: "Yuyudhana, victory in battle today looks certain for me, bull of the Shini line, as these signs show."

verses.text:
सोऽहं तत्र गमिष्यामि यत्र सैन्धवको नृपः ।
यियासुर्यमलोकाय मम वीर्यं प्रतीक्षते ॥

meaning.en: "So I shall go where the Sindhu king is, who, though about to go to Yama's world, waits to test my strength."

verses.text:
यथा परमकं कृत्यं सैन्धवस्य वधे मम ।
तथैव सुमहत्कृत्यं धर्मराजस्य रक्षणे ॥

meaning.en: "As my task of killing Saindhava is of the highest importance, so equally great is the task of guarding Dharmaraja."

verses.text:
स त्वमद्य महाबाहो राजानं परिपालय ।
यथैव हि मया गुप्तस्त्वया गुप्तो भवेत्तथा ॥

meaning.en: "So, mighty-armed one, protect the king today, so that he is as well guarded by you as he would be by me."

verses.text:
त्वयि चाहं पराश्वस्य प्रद्युम्ने वा महारथे ।
शक्नुयां सैन्धवं हन्तुमनपेक्षो नरर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: "With you, or with the great chariot-warrior Pradyumna, to rely on, bull among men, I could kill Saindhava without a care."

verses.text:
मय्यपेक्षा न कर्तव्या कथंचिदपि सात्वत ।
राजन्येव परा गुप्तिः कार्या सर्वात्मना त्वया ॥

meaning.en: "Descendant of Satvata, you should not look to me at all. Guard the king with your whole self."

verses.text:
न हि यत्र महाबाहुर्वासुदेवो व्यवस्थितः ।
किंचिद्व्यापद्यते तत्र यत्राहमपि च ध्रुवम् ॥

meaning.en: "Where the mighty-armed Vasudeva stands, nothing goes wrong, and I too am certainly there."

verses.text:
एवमुक्तस्तु पार्थेन सात्यकिः परवीरहा ।
तथेत्युक्त्वागमत्तत्र यत्र राजा युधिष्ठिरः ॥

meaning.en: Thus addressed by Partha, Satyaki, slayer of enemy heroes, said "So be it" and went where King Yudhishthira was.
